_README: Hand-written half of the config-builder catalogue. `scripts/gen-config-catalog.py` merges
this over what it reads from Workbench's get_default_config() and writes config_catalog.json.
`settings` patches keys that HAVE an upstream default. Recognised fields:
description  one sentence, plain, second person. Shown under the setting name.
shape        overrides the inferred shape. Must be one of SHAPES in the generator.
choices      for enum / nullable_enum. A list of strings, or [value, label] pairs.
group        section in the add-a-setting palette.
browse       'file' or 'dir' -- which picker a file_path setting opens.
unit         suffix shown after an integer input (e.g. 'seconds').
tokens       insertable tokens for a template_string.
required     the builder refuses to save without it. Only `task` is.
locked       written by the app at run time; shown in the locked band, not addable.
skip         not a user setting at all; left out of the catalogue.
default      replaces a default the generator could not evaluate.
`extra` ADDS settings Workbench recognises but has no default for. Same fields, but each
entry is complete rather than a patch. Grow this list as settings come up; the generator
errors if an `extra` key later gains an upstream default, so it cannot silently duplicate.
Descriptions are filled in on demand. An empty one is fine -- the key, shape and default
still carry most of the meaning.

input_csv.description: The processed sheet. Written by the app at run time.

input_dir.description: Folder Workbench reads the input CSV and files from.

secondary_tasks.description: Configs that run in order after this one finishes.

export_file_media_use_term_id.description: Media use term of the files to export.

media_types.description: Media types and the file extensions each one takes.

media_track_file_fields.description: The track (caption) file field on each media type that has one.

ignore_csv_columns.description: Columns in the CSV that Workbench should not try to map to a field.

update_mode.description: How an update task treats values already on the node.

allow_missing_files.description: Keep going when a file named in the CSV isn't on disk.

perform_soft_checks.description: Let --check log missing files, parent order, extension and EDTF errors and keep going.

nodes_only.description: Create the nodes but not their media.

log_file_path.description: Where Workbench writes this run's log.

log_file_mode.description: Set to w to overwrite the log each run instead of appending.

remind_user_to_run_check.description: Ask whether --check was run before starting.

allow_adding_terms.description: Let Workbench create taxonomy terms it does not find.

protected_vocabularies.description: Vocabularies Workbench may never add terms to.

columns_with_term_names.description: CSV columns whose numbers are term names, not term IDs.

validate_terms_exist.description: Have --check confirm each term exists in Drupal. Turn off to speed it up.

timestamp_rollback.description: Stamp rollback files so runs don't overwrite each other.

rollback_file_include_node_info.description: Add the CSV ID, title, field_member_of and file columns to the rollback CSV.

fixity_algorithm.description: Checksum used to verify uploaded files. Unset skips the check.

http_cache_storage.description: Where the response cache lives. Use sqlite if Workbench runs out of memory.

http_retry_on_status_codes.description: HTTP status codes that are retried. Rarely needs changing.

http_retry_allowed_methods.description: HTTP methods that are retried. Rarely needs changing.

http_max_retries.description: How many times to retry a failed request. 0 turns retries off.

http_backoff_factor.description: Sets how long Workbench waits between retries.

http_cache_storage_expire_after.description: How long cached responses are kept.

enable_http_cache.description: Cache responses on this machine. Turn off while troubleshooting.

allow_redirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects from the server.

secure_ssl_only.description: Require valid SSL certificates. Turn off only for test servers.

user_agent.description: User-Agent header sent with every request.

adaptive_pause_threshold.description: How many times slower than average a response must be before adaptive_pause kicks in (rounded down).

redirect_status_code.description: HTTP status code of redirects made by create_redirect.

csv_value_templates.description: Rewrite a column's value before it is sent. $csv_value stands in for the cell's original value.

csv_value_templates_for_paged_content.description: Value templates applied to pages created from subdirectories.

allow_csv_value_templates_if_field_empty.description: Fields filled from a value template when their CSV cell is empty.

csv_value_templates_rand_length.description: Length of the random strings in value templates.

page_title_template.description: Title given to each page node created under a parent.

paged_content_from_directories.description: Create page nodes from the files in each item's directory.

paged_content_from_directories_parents_e.description: The parents of pages created from subdirectories already exist in Drupal.

paged_content_sequence_separator.description: Character between a page file's name and its sequence number.

paged_content_page_weight_multiplier.description: Multiplies page sequence numbers to space out their weights.

paged_content_ignore_files.description: File names or * patterns to skip when scanning page folders.

export_csv_term_mode.description: Export terms as IDs (tid) or names (name).

export_csv_field_list.description: Fields to export. Empty exports all of them.

export_file_directory.description: Folder exported files are written to. Created if missing.

export_file_url_instead_of_download.description: Export file URLs instead of downloading the files.

output_csv_include_input_csv.description: Copy every input CSV column into the output CSV.

contact_sheet_output_dir.description: Folder the contact sheet is written to.

contact_sheet_css_path.description: Stylesheet used for the contact sheet.

csv_id_to_node_id_map_dir.description: Defaults to the system temp folder when unset.

query_csv_id_to_node_id_map_for_parents.description: Look up parents created in earlier Workbench sessions.

text_format_id.description: Text format applied to formatted text fields.

viewer_override_fieldname.description: Field that holds the Islandora Display term.

use_workbench_permissions.description: Use the Islandora Workbench Integration module's permissions.

standalone_media_url.description: Your Drupal has "Standalone media URL" turned on.

drupal_filesystem.description: Drupal file scheme for new files. Only Drupal 9.1 and older need it.

include_password_in_rollback_config_file.description: Copy the password into the rollback config.

remove_password_from_config_file.description: Remove the password from this config once Workbench has read it.

use_node_title_for_media_title.description: Name media after their parent node's title.

remote_file_cookie_name.description: Session cookie name sent when downloading remote files.

remote_file_cookie_value.description: Session cookie value sent with remote_file_cookie_name.

validate_parent_node_exists.description: Have --check confirm each field_member_of node exists.

delete_media_by_node_media_use_tids.description: Only delete media with these media use terms. Empty deletes all.

update_media_by_node_media_use_tids.description: Only update media with these media use terms.

ignore_existing_parent_ids.description: Only use parent IDs recorded during this run, not earlier sessions.

ignore_duplicate_parent_ids.description: When a parent ID is in the CSV ID map more than once, use the newest entry.

media_type_by_media_use.description: Media type to use for each media use term, for additional files.

exit_on_recovery_mode_parent_lookup_fail.description: Stop a resumed create when a parent can't be found.

task.description: What this run does to Islandora.
choices: create_from_files - Create nodes from a folder of files
delete - Delete nodes and their media
add_media - Add media to existing nodes
update_media - Update media fields or replace files
update_media_by_node - Update media, found by node ID
delete_media - Delete media by media ID
delete_media_by_node - Delete media by node ID
export_csv - Export node fields to CSV
get_data_from_view - Export from a Drupal View
get_media_report_from_view - Media report from a View
create_terms - Populate a vocabulary from CSV
add_alt_text - Add alt text to images
run_scripts - Run scripts on existing entities

csv_rows_to_process.description: Only process the rows with these IDs, listed here or in a file.

additional_files.description: CSV columns that create extra media, each with its media use term.

field_text_format_ids.description: Text format for each formatted text field.

mimetype_extensions.description: File extension for MIME types the default mapping gets wrong.

rollback_csv_file_path.description: Where the rollback CSV is written.

rollback_file_comments.description: Comment lines added to the rollback config and CSV.

paged_content_page_content_type.description: Content type of pages, when it differs from the parent's.

media_type.description: Media type for every file, overriding the per-extension mapping. Required by add_media and update_media.

vocab_id.description: Machine name of the vocabulary create_terms and update_terms work on.

paged_content_additional_page_media.description: Media Use term to file extension, for extra page files such as OCR text.

models.description: Model term per file extension, for create_from_files.
